tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search public bilingual catalog metadata by keywords or natural-language questions. Returns relevant articles ranked by metadata matches, or zero results when no meaningful match exists. An empty query lists all articles. This tool never returns private article text.

tools.name: get_purchase_instructions
tools.description: Get machine-readable instructions for purchasing the full private article using x402 v2. Returns the paid API URL, request schema, payment network, expected price, and safe payment workflow. Does not initiate a payment or return private content.
